title: Flawless Experimental Battlelord
summary: Break the research operation before facing a battlelord backed by dormant mutations.
overview: Break the research operation before facing a battlelord backed by dormant mutations.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Keep an alternate tank ready for Throw and reserve add control for mutation activations.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Kill the separated research subjects, then the researchers they unlock, to reveal the final room.
Every two minutes of combat, the battlelord briefly grows stronger and activates the next mutation group.
Throw occurs on a one-minute timer and can remove the leading target from hate lists.
Defeat both final researchers while the battlelord is still alive to satisfy the bonus chest condition.
After 30 seconds out of combat, the encounter restores its adds.

notes: Approval E282. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
